mapper.select: SELECT * FROM tb_tank ORDER BY fuel_type ASC, tank_name ASC
SELECT * FROM tb_tank WHERE fuel_type = #{fuelType} ORDER BY tank_name ASC
SELECT * FROM tb_tank WHERE status IN ('WARNING', 'DANGER') ORDER BY FIELD(status, 'DANGER', 'WARNING'), tank_name ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tb_tank (tank_name, fuel_type, max_capacity, current_volume, temperature, water_level, threshold_warning, threshold_danger, status, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{tankName}, #{fuelType}, #{maxCapacity}, #{currentVolume}, #{temperature}, #{waterLevel}, #{thresholdWarning}, #{thresholdDanger}, #{status}, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE tb_tank SET current_volume = #{currentVolume}, status = #{status}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE tank_id = #{tankId}
UPDATE tb_tank SET max_capacity = #{maxCapacity}, current_volume = #{currentVolume}, status = #{status}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE tank_id = #{tankId}
UPDATE tb_tank SET temperature = #{temperature}, water_level = #{waterLevel}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE tank_id = #{tankId}
mapper.select: SELECT s.in_date AS metricDate, COALESCE(SUM(s.in_volume), 0) AS metricValue FROM tb_stock_in s WHERE s.tank_id = #{tankId} AND s.in_date BETWEEN #{from} AND #{to} GROUP BY s.in_date ORDER BY s.in_date ASC

SELECT DATE(t.tx_datetime) AS metricDate, COALESCE(SUM(t.liter), 0) AS metricValue FROM tb_transaction t WHERE t.tank_id = #{tankId} AND DATE(t.tx_datetime) BETWEEN #{from} AND #{to} GROUP BY DATE(t.tx_datetime) ORDER BY DATE(t.tx_datetime) ASC

SELECT a.adj_date AS metricDate, COALESCE(SUM(a.diff_volume), 0) AS metricValue FROM tb_stock_adjustment a WHERE a.tank_id = #{tankId} AND a.adj_date BETWEEN #{from} AND #{to} GROUP BY a.adj_date ORDER BY a.adj_date ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tb_tank_daily_level ( tank_id, level_date, end_volume_liters, source ) VALUES ( #{tankId}, #{levelDate}, #{endVolumeLiters}, #{source} ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE end_volume_liters = VALUES(end_volume_liters), source = VALUES(source), updated_at = NOW()
mapper.select: SELECT end_volume_liters FROM tb_tank_daily_level WHERE tank_id = #{tankId} ORDER BY level_date DESC LIMIT 1
